slides.title: 14 pages. 12 new screenshots.
slides.body: Game Informer's new cover story is all GTA 6: real weather systems, storms and tons of wildlife across Leonida.
slides.punch: Florida Man now comes with a weather forecast.

slides.title: Game not included.
slides.body: The $399.99 collector's box launches on November 19. The game itself? Sold separately.

slides.title: Still no PC version.
slides.body: GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only. Rockstar's past PC ports arrived 12 to 19 months after console.
